title: Learn it first links
description: Free official lessons for one topic (Oak National Academy and BBC Bitesize). Links only: nothing is loaded from those sites until the student taps one. One file per topic, named <topic id>.json.

topic.description: Id of a topic in content/topic-trees/.

title.description: The page title exactly as the provider shows it.

board.description: Only for a board-specific page: must match the topic tree's board.

checked_at.description: ISO date the link was last confirmed working (the CI link check), or null until then. The app only shows checked links.
